adopted_reasons_as_supplied_not_recomput: Saved fixed H4 DF result: RF1/EW2 sufficient step about 1.71e-4 Ha^-1; centered structured Cbar2 about 1.69e-2 Ha^-1; about99-fold difference as quoted in the completed review.
Independent implementation checkers accepted; all four route boundaries ENCLOSED. This is not an interrupted or arithmetically unresolved result.

No reasonable basis to rescue this fixed evidence route solely by changing d, alpha_spec or arithmetic resolution; the completed reviews paper diagnostics are archived, not independently re-proved here.
Current PSD cap, W, Lambda, raw K_SOS and RF domain constrain this practical route. No new mechanism or improved certificate is established by this record.

About343 seconds is pipeline cost, largely structured commutator generation/checking, and must not all be charged to the relative-form route. Standalone total costs and quantum costs are not established.
reconsideration_requires: Concrete lawful mechanism addressing Lambda/relative bound/structure-preserving finite remainder, or a separately justified useful input class and evidence-cost objective.
Fair access to all improved information for both routes; explicit acquisition/verification costs and stated assumptions.
Separate user policy approval before reopening; separate scientific review start approval when needed and separate execution approval before any new scientific calculation.
